consequence.statement: The health.status.lastTransitionTime field on Application resources will now always be set with a timestamp value, whereas it was previously sometimes omitted.

original.statement: The Argo CD controller now consistently sets health.status.lastTransitionTime on Application resources, whereas previously this field was sometimes not set.

decision.reason: [ev-5d698f8b4038] is a bug-fix changelog line saying the controller now "always" sets health.status.lastTransitionTime, which implies it was sometimes left unset before. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so a failure kind is not supported. Behavior-change (review) with low severity fits a status field that is now populated more consistently. The CRD snapshots [ev-04f25237d9d5][ev-be3337c2717d] confirm the field exists in both releases, so this is not a schema change.
